items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You know Charlie Leisure. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: People from away and trouble here. That's right.

So, what I did, I said, Chuck is out. Eddie, get in the load and get cramped in his legs. So, I got Brady. We had a big job coming up over there. I got Brady. I got Brady. And I told him to get me a guitar player. You know Charlie Leisure. Yeah.
